thread:
Priya R: Quick heads-up — we're proposing to sunset the old `/v1/auth` SDK header behavior used by partner integrations. Goal: discovery + gating plan for Marketplace and SI partners. Draft timeline: deprecate in 90 days, block new listings at 120, remove in 180. Need impact notes from everyone.
Samir K: ok — are we sure this is just a control-plane header change and not something that will break Dedicated/Private runtimes?
Tom B: short answer: runtime unaffected. It's an auth handshake change in the control plane + partner SDKs. Dedicated/private customers who pin older control plane versions could be impacted if they upgrade.
Evelyn Z: can we get a short checklist to share with partners (so PMs/RMs can copy/paste)?
Priya R: yes — starting checklist (copy for outreach):
• Identify customers using legacy `/v1/auth` header in partner SDKs
• Inventory Marketplace listings and SI bundles referencing old header (manifest + docs)
• Provide compatibility shim examples (client-side) and a server-side migration guide
• Set canary customers and testing dates + rollback plan
• Coordinate marketplace gating policy (block new listing uploads after date)
• Publish deprecation announcement + partner FAQ
Samir K: can we include a tiny compatibility shim snippet? partners always ask for code.
Tom B: sure — add this to checklist. Example shim clients can paste into their SDKs:
```
// shim: accept both headers for now
const headers = {
  'Authorization': token, // new canonical header
  'X-Old-Auth': token // legacy fallback for 90-day window
};
fetch('/v1/generate', { headers });
```
Evelyn Z: +1. Also add a small healthcheck curl they can run to validate listing support:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/model/ping
# should return 200 + {"ok":true, "version":"..."}
```
SI-Team: flagged — we have two SI bundles (SI-Delta, SI-Orbit) that embed the older header in their installer templates. Both require a maintainer update; estimate ~6 weeks to ship patch. Can we extend the deprecation window for them? :thinking_face:
HW-Partner: firmware-side: no change. Our onboard SDK layer is pure userland and can be updated by partners without infra work.
audit-bot: Ticket created PRTN-452: "partner header sunset — partner inventory & marketplace gating" (assignees: @Samir K, @Tom B)
Priya R: thanks — Samir, can you lead partner comms? Tom / EngDocs please publish migration guide by EOD next Tue. Evelyn, can you add a test harness to the partner CI checklist and a quick runnable script?
Samir K: will do. I'll draft partner email + support template and share in #partnerships/partners-distro.
Tom B: I'll put migration doc in the docs repo and add a short rollback plan. For Dedicated/Private: recommend customers pin control plane version until they validate the new header. Add to the doc.
Evelyn Z: putting a simple test script here for partners to run in CI:
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
TOKEN=$1
# test both headers work during migration window
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/model/ping || exit 1
curl -s -H "X-Old-Auth: $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/model/ping || exit 1
echo "compatibility checks passed"
```
SI-Team: we'll queue patches into our next sprint. Thanks for the extra runway note.
Priya R: final ask: partners, reply here with (1) estimated # of affected customers, (2) ETA for SDK/installer patch, (3) any legal/contract blockers for marketplace policy. We'll collate and send the formal deprecation notice by end of week. :pray:
SI-Team: (1) ~4 customers, (2) 6 weeks, (3) none known.
HW-Partner: (1) 0, (2) patch done by partner teams in 1 week, (3) none.
Samir K: putting together the RM list and customer-impact spreadsheet — will post link when ready. :spiral_calendar:
Priya R: perfect. I'll follow up with the gating policy draft and recommended dates. Thanks all — great sync. :thumbsup:
